pattern.name: spec_file_structure
pattern.template:
# <Feature Name> Test Plan
## Application Overview
<Description of the application and its key features>
Key features include: - <Feature 1> - <Feature 2> - <Feature 3>
## Test Scenarios
### 1. <Scenario Group Name>
**Seed:** `tests/seed.spec.ts`
#### 1.1 <Scenario Name>
**Steps:** 1. <Action 1> 2. <Action 2> 3. <Action 3>
**Expected Results:** - <Result 1> - <Result 2>
#### 1.2 <Next Scenario>
**Steps:** 1. <Action 1>
**Expected Results:** - <Result 1>

| Data Type | Description | Source | |-----------|-------------|--------| | User Credentials | Valid login credentials | fixtures | | Test Content | Sample data for testing | assets/test_data/ |

pattern.name: positive_test_scenario
pattern.template:
#### <Number>.<Number> <Action> Successfully
**Steps:** 1. Navigate to <page> 2. <Action 1> 3. <Action 2>
**Expected Results:** - <Success indicator 1> - <Success indicator 2>

pattern.name: negative_test_scenario
pattern.template:
#### <Number>.<Number> <Action> With Invalid Input
**Steps:** 1. Navigate to <page> 2. Enter invalid data: <description> 3. Submit form
**Expected Results:** - Error message displayed: <text> - Form remains visible - Data not submitted

pattern.name: edge_case_scenario
pattern.template:
#### <Number>.<Number> <Action> With Edge Case
**Steps:** 1. <Setup> 2. <Action with boundary value>
**Expected Results:** - <Expected behavior>
